decisions.question: SDD pre-flight for nidana.model.5 (gate-only; three tasks; code dry-run against the real replay tool to 117/117): which model implements?

options.label: Sonnet for every task
options.consequence: Transcription of verified code at mid-tier cost, as nidana.model.3 and .4 did without a defect in their declarations.

options.label: Opus
options.consequence: More cost for the same transcription.

decisions.why: S97's rule and the precedent of the two earlier declaration phases, whose task reviews found the transcriptions exact.

decisions.question: Which Learnings does nidana.model.5's slim verification doc carry?

options.label: Four, each dropped with a reason: the one-code marker held for all 22 reject libraries of the node's contracts, the surface fixture never using ScopeViolation or TopicDeclaration const, the two temporary ignores, the size
options.consequence: The owner sees the closed routed check, the one fixture coverage gap the dry run found, and what nidana.model.11 must undo.

options.label: None beyond the size
options.consequence: The fixture coverage gap would reach the owner only through the routed list.

decisions.chosen: Four, each dropped with a reason: the one-code marker held for all 22 reject libraries of the node's contracts, the surface fixture never using ScopeViolation or TopicDeclaration const, the two temporary ignores, the size
decisions.why: Each is a gate-time finding about the tree; the fixture gap is the kind of contract fixture weakness hsdd-contract owns, batched into the end-of-node sweep.

decisions.question: nidana.model.5's Task 3 review found the controller's own Learning 2 ruling wrong (it named TopicDeclaration as unpinned, but the surface fixture builds it const), and the final review later left three cosmetic notes in the doc. Fix rounds and merge?

options.label: Correct Learning 2 in a fix round; merge with the three cosmetic notes parked
options.consequence: The doc the owner signs states only true facts; a literal <base> in one pasted command and two wording slips remain, each noted in the archived ledger.

options.label: A fix wave for the cosmetic notes too
options.consequence: One more implementer and re-review for wording that misstates nothing.

decisions.chosen: Correct Learning 2 in a fix round; merge with the three cosmetic notes parked
decisions.why: A false fact in a signed record is a defect; cosmetic wording is not. The error originated in the orchestrator's ruling text, so the run's routed note was corrected too.
evidence: S116 final review (ready to merge: yes)

notes: SDD controller rulings are the decisions here; the per-task review log is docs/auto-run/steps/S116.sdd-progress.md.
Dispatches: 3 implementers (sonnet), 3 task reviews (sonnet), 1 fix round on Task 3 with its re-review (run beside the final review), 1 final review (opus).
